assumptions: Knee: one coordinate with Gait2392's coupling; the tibia origin moves along the model's two translation splines (about 6.3 mm anterior and 21.1 mm inferior from 0 to 100 deg flexion). A model fit, not measured knee motion; no rolling contact, no patella body, no other knee rotations (D-060 simplification 1)
Female and male bodies: the knee splines scaled by stature / 1.8 m, like their other joint locations
Segment masses, centres of mass and inertias are D1's, fixed in their own body frames; the thigh centre of mass converted once from D1's fixed knee datum (ChatGPT note D3-N02)
Motion: D1's demonstration squat, not re-searched for the new knee (D-060 simplification 2)
Muscles: D2's 14 actuators, force law and two-stage recruitment, with the femur placed by the moving knee; D2's simplifications 2-15 apply; simplification 1 (D1's fixed knee) does not

omitted_physics.knee: Gait2392's one-coordinate coupling only; no knee contact mechanics, patella, ligaments or out-of-plane rotations
omitted_physics.other: As in D-058 and D-059: sagittal plane, foot fixed, no activation dynamics, rigid tendons, no passive force in the baseline

assumptions: 1. Sagittal model with D1's fixed-centre knee and z-axis ankle applied to Gait2392 muscle paths
2. Instantaneous recruitment: no activation dynamics, no muscle history; D1's inertial torques are kept
3. The criterion predicts no co-contraction beyond what the torques force
4. Rigid tendons (most questionable for soleus and gastrocnemius)
5. No passive fiber force in the baseline
6. Gait2392 muscle strengths (Delp's values scaled upward, not uniformly) and paths built for gait; deep-flexion paths not checked against measurements
7. Maximum isometric forces not scaled to the female and male bodies; they are stature-scaled demonstration profiles with Gait2392's generic strengths, not sex-specific strength models
8. De Groote curves instead of the Millard curves named in the model file
9. Gluteus maximus compartments and gastrocnemius heads treated as independent actuators
10. Muscles left out: biceps femoris short head, adductor magnus, iliopsoas and all other Gait2392 muscles; leaving out the short head is a scope choice, not shown harmless
11. Fiber damping 0 (the Millard file would otherwise give 0.1 through conversion)
12. Curve domain enforced; out-of-domain actuators excluded at that sample, not extrapolated
13. Forces along coordinates other than D1's three are absorbed by ideal joint constraints; no joint-reaction or contact-stress prediction
14. Female and male bodies: path points, optimal fiber lengths and tendon slack lengths scaled by stature / 1.8 m
15. Path-length jumps at Gait2392's conditional via points are kept, not smoothed; values are evaluated per branch

baseline_force_law.curves: De Groote et al. 2016 as implemented in sources/vendor/opensim-core/DeGrooteFregly2016Muscle.h (constants read from the file)
baseline_force_law.domain: x = L - l_ts > 0; l_M / l_opt in [0.2, 1.8]; normalized fiber velocity in [-1, 1]. Out of domain: actuator excluded at that sample and flagged; non-finite: failure
baseline_force_law.fiber_velocity: v_M = cos(alpha) dL/dt, lengthening positive; normalized by v_max * l_opt

omitted_physics.activation_dynamics: Omitted: activation is chosen instantaneously at each sample
omitted_physics.co_contraction: Not predicted beyond what the torques require
omitted_physics.measured_activity: No comparison with measured muscle activity (EMG); physiological validity not claimed
omitted_physics.passive_tissue: Omitted: passive fiber force (baseline), ligaments, joint capsules
omitted_physics.tendon_compliance: Omitted in the baseline: tendons are inextensible

d1_consistency_N_m.rationale: Recomputed D1 torques must equal the official D1 manifest, which stores them to 6 decimals

epsilon_reserve.rationale: Per-joint reserve allowance for muscle_feasibility (D-059 item 3, Amendment 2): feasible when the smallest largest reserve t* is at or below it. Not sourced and not physiological

kkt_tolerance.rationale: Largest stationarity, dual-feasibility, complementarity or primal residual accepted for either stage (D-059 8d)

passive_strain_sensitivity.rationale: De Groote default passive strain at one normalized force (DeGrooteFregly2016Muscle.cpp at opensim-core 01683ac), set explicitly for the passive-on sensitivity case only (Amendment 1)

second_solver_activation_tolerance.rationale: Agreement of quadprog (active set) and Clarabel (interior point) on stage-2 activations

second_solver_t_star_tolerance.rationale: Agreement of HiGHS dual simplex and HiGHS interior point on t*

solver_band_delta.rationale: Stage 2 allows |reserve| <= t* + delta; also the tolerance for counting a computed t* as zero (Amendment 1, item 3). Reported separately from t* (ChatGPT note D2-A2-N01)
